Make an Image Square Without Cropping
Keep your whole photo. This free fit-to-square tool pads the shorter sides with any background color — nothing gets cut off, and nothing is uploaded.
Drop an image here, or browse
PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 25 MB. You can also paste from your clipboard.
Runs entirely in your browser. Your image is never uploaded.
How to make a picture square without cropping it
- 01Upload your imageDrag and drop, browse, or paste any PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF. The fit-to-square tool opens it instantly in your browser.
- 02Pick a backgroundYour whole photo is placed on a square canvas. Choose white, black, transparent, any custom color, or a blurred fill of the same image.
- 03Download the squareSave a full-resolution 1:1 PNG with your entire image intact — no cropping, no watermark, no signup.
Square the canvas, not the photo
Cropping is the obvious way to get a square image — but it costs you pixels. A full-body portrait loses feet or a head, a landscape loses its sky, a poster loses its title. This tool takes the opposite approach: it keeps your entire photo and grows the canvas instead, padding the shorter sides with a background until the image is a perfect 1:1 square.
